correctness.rationale: The Fock basis yields the exact two-step shift and Hermitian Jacobi commutator. Off-diagonal coefficients are n^-3/2 when ab is nonzero; diagonal entries are n^-2. Absolute summability gives trace class and telescoping gives trace 8|a|^2. For p>2/3 componentwise S_p suffices; for p<=2/3 the separated coordinate compression has singular values |c_{4k}| and forces divergence. Pure cases are diagonal n^-2. Indefinite separated 2x2 blocks yield both infinite spectral inertias; exact finite matrix and rational telescoping were replayed from the new checker (258 tests).

value.rationale: The entire natural degree-two bounded-symbol class on Gaussian Fock space receives a sharp invariant classification for its self-commutators. A nonzero mixed term changes the spectral ideal boundary from 1/2 to 2/3 and generates infinitely many signs at arbitrarily small perturbation, while the trace remains rigid. This is structurally motivated by the literature on Fock integration operators and not a re-expression of their norm, compactness or spectrum.
